title: Organic Chemistry I
description: An introductory organic chemistry course covering structure and bonding, resonance, acid-base chemistry, alkanes and cycloalkanes, stereochemistry, reaction mechanisms, alkenes and alkynes, substitution and elimination, alcohols/ethers/epoxides, and structure determination by IR and NMR spectroscopy.

topics.title: Structure, Bonding, and Hybridization
topics.description: This section develops structure, bonding, and hybridization through the concrete vocabulary, procedures, examples, and checks students need in Organic Chemistry I.
